patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff carries the correct source-side fix for this bug (`if (UNLIKELY(size >= helper->buffer->len)) return NULL;`) but `switch-fixed --patch patch.diff` failed because the diff also contains a binary testcase hunk that `git apply` rejected without a full index line. Fixed-side verification therefore uses the authoritative `n132/arvo:14455-fix` image with the frozen fixed instrumentation patch applied on top.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before the parser advances `buffer` past the fixed PROXY v2 header, the claimed header size `size` must be strictly less than the logical request extent `request->helper->buffer->len`; otherwise the remaining-span computation will underflow and the later `memmem()` search will operate outside the admitted request bytes.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original checks only `size > sizeof(*hdr)` and admits the truncated 13-byte witness with `size == 16`. The fixed original enforces the missing conjunct before any cursor advance, so the original case is guarded and the adjacent `len=17` boundary case becomes the genuine witness that still executes the protected `memmem` call.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: In the vulnerable original trace, `claimed_size=16` and `request_len=13`, so the required predicate is violated while `proxy_v2_memmem_sink` executes. In the fixed original trace the same predicate is false but the protected sink is absent (`guarded`). The closest source-grounded boundary perturbation `proxy_v2_len17_boundary` makes the predicate true (`16 < 17`) and the fixed trace reaches `proxy_v2_memmem_sink`, giving the required genuine witness.

nodes.description: After `buffer += size`, the remaining-span expression `(size_t)(helper->buffer->value + helper->buffer->len - buffer)` wraps to a huge `size_t` when the cursor has moved past the logical request end. In the vulnerable witness this yields `adjusted_size = 18446744073709551613` while `helper->buffer->len = 13`.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `proxy_v2_search_window.window_len=18446744073709551613` and `proxy_v2_search_window.request_len=13`, satisfying `window_len > request_len`.

nodes.description: At the sanitizer sink `helper->crlfcrlf = memmem(buffer, adjusted_size, "\r\n\r\n", 4);`, the second argument is the same underflowed `adjusted_size` computed at line 277, so `memmem()` receives the wrapped `size_t` search length that ASan reports as `negative-size-param (size=-3)`.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace shows `proxy_v2_search_window.window_len == proxy_v2_memmem_sink.window_len == 18446744073709551613`.

edges.description: The unchecked claimed PROXY v2 size is the exact cursor offset after `buffer += size`, so the root-cause `size` value becomes the past-end search-start offset observed at the remaining-window computation.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `proxy_v2_guard.claimed_size == proxy_v2_search_window.start_offset == 16`.

edges.description: The wrapped `adjusted_size` produced by the negative remaining-span cast is passed unchanged from the local `adjusted_size` computation into the `memmem()` sink.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `proxy_v2_search_window.window_len == proxy_v2_memmem_sink.window_len == 18446744073709551613`.
